Author: Null
Name: Chocobo Color Calculator
Punchline: Plan and track an accurate chocobo color feeding route in game.
Description: Calculates and tracks ordered fruit routes between companion chocobo colors.
Changelog: Refined the modern layout with compact plumage selectors, metrics, shopping list, tracking controls, and route spacing. Decorative cards no longer show nested scrollbars, and the main scrollbar now appears only when the window actually needs it.
